issues.description: The problem (Aufgabe 02) asks for the number (count) of Gemeinden in the Regierungsbezirk 'Oberbayern', but the solution file returns the names of the Gemeinden instead. This produces a different result shape/type (multiple name strings instead of a single numeric count) and will confuse students comparing the solution to the task.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the solution to return the count of Gemeinden. For example: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Gemeinde WHERE regierungsbezirk='Oberbayern'; This aligns the solution output with the task requirement and avoids confusion about the expected result shape.
